captions.detailed: A flat, circular coin featuring an intricate, engraved geometric pattern on its top surface. The pattern consists of intersecting circles, arcs, lines, and dots arranged in a ring, resembling circular Gallifreyan writing. The engraving is shallow and clean, leaving the outer rim and the central area of the coin flat and smooth.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric circular coin featuring circular Gallifreyan text engraved on its surface. The script should allow customization of the input word, coin radius, thickness, and the circular path radius where the characters are arranged.
captions.factory: The code generates a flat cylinder using a linear_extrude of a circle primitive to form the main coin body. A difference operation subtracts the circular Gallifreyan writing from the top surface. The writing is procedurally generated using linear_extrude of 2D circle and square primitives, positioned dynamically using translate, rotate, and custom trigonometric helper functions that parse the input string.
